text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging: High error rate and spikes in OOMs during model warmup across eu-west-1. Auto-escalation to on-call. Details: /incidents/7580012468
oncall-robin: I'm on it. Observed sudden increase in model-init failures and node reboots. Starting triage.
oncall-robin: @sre-alex can you pull latest node logs and GPU dmesg? Suspect CUDA driver resets.
sre-alex: grabbing logs now. seeing repeated `cuda:device lost` entries + oom_killer messages on kworker. Also lots of kvcache evictions.
runtime-jen: load path shows heavy simultaneous warmups for mult-model pool. KV cache thrash + prefix caching churn.
ml-load-kim: model artifacts look fine checksum-wise. But some nodes failed deserializing large fusion blocks: `deserialize: EOF while reading` in warmup step.
sre-alex: paste logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T12:37:40Z] runtime: model warmup start model=redwood-rl-7b
[2026-03-17T12:37:41Z] cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T12:37:41Z] kernel: oom_killer invoked pid=4321
[2026-03-17T12:37:42Z] runtime: deserialize error: EOF while reading block
[2026-03-17T12:37:43Z] node: watchdog triggered, rebooting
```
support-lina: customer alpha-inc reported latency spikes and 5xxs starting 12:37. They're affected by dedicated endpoints pinned to eu-west-1.
oncall-robin: immediate mitigation: 1) enable fallback routing to quantized variant for pinned endpoints 2) pause new warmups on eu-west-1 3) start draining one suspect host for forensic capture.
runtime-jen: pausing warmups in region: set `max_concurrent_warmups=1` and reduce `prefetch_kv=true->false` on active pools. Applying now.
infra-paul: starting drain of host gwu-12-09. snapshotting GPU memory and collecting /sys/fs logs.
ml-load-kim: creating an artifact validity check job to scan model shards for truncated blocks; kicking off across pool.
sre-alex: forking a small canary route to dedicated fallback pool in us-east-1 for alpha-inc. Will update routing policy to `prefer:fallback_pool` for their endpoints.
support-lina: informing alpha-inc that we have a mitigation in flight, routing to fallback may add <200ms RTT but should remove 5xxs. Sending proactive notice.
oncall-robin: rolling back any recent infra changes? Were there driver updates earlier today?
infra-paul: no driver changes in last 24h. But there's a kernel micro-patch auto-rolled yesterday evening on some nodes in eu-West fleet.
runtime-jen: hypothesis: kernel patch changed slab allocator timing leading to faster eviction, combined with a thundering warmup causing concurrent KV cache loads -> GPU allocations fail -> deserialize partial reads -> node watchdog.
ml-load-kim: to validate: we'll replay warmup on a repro node with instrumentation for partial reads and increase artifact read timeouts.
sre-alex: temporary auto-scale down of warmup parallelism deployed. Cloud autoscaler bumped no. of hosts but warmup storm outran cache.
oncall-robin: set incident severity to SEV2 due to customer impact and node reboots.
incident-bot: Incident updated: SEV2 | Incident lead: oncall-robin | Timeline link: https://redwood.incidents/7580012468
runtime-jen: applied `deserialize.read_timeout=30s` on warmup path to fail-fast instead of partial corruption.
ml-load-kim: artifact scan found 0 corrupted checksums; deserializations failing mid-read correlate with GPU allocation failures mid-stream.
infra-paul: we patched watchdog threshold to avoid aggressive reboots while we stabilize; moved suspect nodes into maintenance.
support-lina: alpha-inc confirmed 5xxs cleared after routing to fallback. They want ETA for full recovery and whether data/requests were lost.
oncall-robin: full recovery depends on reducing warmup concurrency and completing artifact replay tests. ETA 90m for stabilization and safe reintroduction of traffic.
ml-load-kim: plan: (A) repro and confirm deserial failures are caused by mid-read OOM (B) add retry-attempts in warmup deserializer (C) add metrics to surface partial read counts.
runtime-jen: also adding throttling heuristic: if kvcache eviction rate > 200/s then throttle new warmups to 1/min per pool.
sre-alex: collecting list of impacted customer endpoints and applying canary checks before re-enabling pinned routing.
oncall-robin: action items assigned: infra-paul collect forensic artifacts (ongoing), runtime-jen deploy throttles + timeouts (done), ml-load-kim run replay + patch deserializer (in progress), support-lina coordinate customer comms.
incident-bot: Next update in 15m or on status change. React with :eyes: when you've acknowledged.
oncall-robin: acknowledged :eyes:
sre-alex: adding retrospective note: consider defaulting to quantized fallback earlier for warmup storms.
support-lina: will file customer-impact summary once we confirm list of affected endpoints.
ml-load-kim: patching deserializer to catch partial reads and retry on fresh allocation, will push change to canary in ~25m.
oncall-robin: thumbs for progress. Keep logs and artifacts in /incidents/7580012468/artifacts.
incident-bot: Incident timeline entry created by oncall-robin at 2026-03-17T12:44:32Z.
